title: iew-monday-metal-2002-world-heavyweight
label: Tom Tombstone

won.source: Awakening, 17 March 2002: 'the NEW IEW World Heavyweight Champion... Tom Tombstone'.

how: Won the tournament final over Jared Sengir.
note: The last reign this record reaches.

title: iew-monday-metal-2002-north-american
label: "Simply Electric" Eli Johnson

won.source: Monday Metal, 25 February 2002: 'NEW IEW North American Champion... Simply Electric Eli Johnson'.

how: Won the battle royal for the vacant title.
note: Retained in a three-way Hell in the Cell against Chico Broheem and Stupac at Awakening, 17 March 2002, the last reign this record reaches.
